title: ApplyEdit (live edit fast-path) has zero test coverage despite being the production entry point
detail: New public API with NONE coverage. The E10 live/replay equivalence claim (ApplyEdit-logged commands replay byte-identically via Step) is only tested on the replay side; invalid-edit-not-logged is untested.
recommended_fix: Add a dual-runner test: apply edits via ApplyEdit on one state, replay the resulting ActionLog via Step on another, assert identical StateHash at every boundary; assert a rejected edit is not logged.

title: Routing tier-cost steering (capacity-cost ladder) untested — all routing tests use uniform TIER_STANDARD
evidence: PP_Routing.h:215: "MinCost[Ns] = C; // a fatter (cheaper) member re-prices the edge"; PP_Balance.h:38: "inline constexpr int32_t kTierCost[TIER_COUNT] = {20, 10, 5};" — every routing test draws TIER_STANDARD only (tests/spine_check.cpp:194-197 "PP::ApplyDraw(T4, S4, RA, PP::TIER_STANDARD);" diamond; grep shows TIER_WIDE appears only in bundle cap tests)
detail: The locked routing model's core behavior — lower-cost (fatter) tiers winning route selection, and mixed-tier bundles pricing at the cheapest member — has NONE coverage. A cost-table regression would pass every test.
recommended_fix: Add a test with two asymmetric paths (narrow vs wide) asserting the wide path is chosen, plus a parallel-pipe case asserting the mixed-tier bundle prices at min member cost.

title: Failed replayed command → ReplayError latch has no test (only the backward-tick trigger is covered)
detail: Error-handling blind spot: the header calls a failed replayed command a CRITICAL divergence, but no test feeds an invalid command to Step and asserts the latch. Happy-path-only coverage of the replay contract's error branch.
recommended_fix: Add a dual-runner test: Step with an invalid command (e.g. span-exceeding draw) in the Commands array; assert State.ReplayError latches and stays latched.

title: E29 recovery and no-route WaitingTicks path only partially covered — drop-back asserted, retry/redelivery never
detail: PARTIAL coverage: the drop-back is tested, but the WaitingTicks increment on a persistently unreachable dst and successful re-delivery after reconnection are never exercised. No boundary test for the wait/retry loop.
recommended_fix: Extend the E29 test: keep the edge severed several ticks (assert WaitingTicks climbs), restore/re-draw it, assert the packet re-forwards and delivers.

title: Multi-packet bundle capacity contention in the serve pass has no coverage
detail: The FIFO capacity split across simultaneous packets on one bundle — the congestion mechanic — is untested; only the lone-packet (full-capacity) path runs. Remaining-accounting bugs would pass all gates.
recommended_fix: Add a test seeding two packets onto one standard bundle in overlapping ticks; assert per-tick progress splits 15/0 in FIFO order and both deliver at the expected ticks.

title: FEditError::UnknownTier validation branch untested
detail: P3 defensive-validation gap: the tier-bounds rejection is never exercised on either runner. Low risk, but it is a reachable error path.
recommended_fix: Add one CHECK/TestTrue asserting ApplyDraw with Tier=TIER_COUNT returns FEditError::UnknownTier in spine_check and the UE suite.

title: Degenerate spawn (Src == Dst counted delivered) untested
detail: P3 boundary gap: the src==dst spawn branch is a state transition with score impact; no test pins it. A future refactor could drop or double-count it silently.
recommended_fix: Add a spine-check/UE check: FlowSeedDemand with Src==Dst, step one tick, assert Score increments and the packet is culled.

title: BundleTier (highest member tier, the render-width proxy) never asserted
detail: P3 gap: the highest-member-tier field of the mixed-tier bundle (the render-width proxy) is computed but never checked, including in the existing 15+40 mixed-tier fixtures.
recommended_fix: Extend the existing mixed-tier bundle tests (spine_check + FPPBundleCapSum) to assert BundleTier equals TIER_WIDE.

title: StepScenario's 16-commands-per-tick cap silently drops log entries — boundary untested
detail: P3 boundary blind spot in shared golden infrastructure: >16 same-tick commands are dropped silently, which would corrupt replay equality with no failure signal. Current scenario uses 2.
recommended_fix: Either assert N==matching-entry count (fail loud on overflow) or add a boundary test with 17 same-tick commands documenting the truncation.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: P0 spine fully covered on both runners (tests/spine_check.cpp golden: "CHECK(Hash == 0x5e440f9c5a28892aull, \"golden state_hash must match the committed golden\")"; replay: "CHECK(HashA == PP::StateHash(B), \"same seed + same ticks must replay identical\")"; compare-golden.sh --self-test rejects a corrupted golden); gaps: PP_Sim.h:41 ApplyEdit untested, PP_Routing.h:215 tier-cost steering untested, PP_Sim.h:76 failed-command latch untested, PP_Flow.h:160 E29 recovery partial, PP_Flow.h:243 contention untested
detail: P0 100%; P1 ≈82% (11.5/14 behaviors — two P1 behaviors at 0%, two partial); overall ≈80%. Determinism spine and golden discipline are exemplary; gaps cluster on the live-edit path and cost model.
recommended_fix: Add the ApplyEdit live/replay-equivalence test and the tier-cost-steering test (lifts P1 to ≥90% → PASS); then the E29-recovery and serve-contention tests for margin.
